en: You are deemed a threat!
The totem is made, $n.
%s disabled ghost region.

Oh, you're looking for Springspindle Fizzlegear then.  Why that little gnome and his gadgets...  Let me tell you, if you're going to his shop in Tinker Town, keep your hands to yourself and don't pet any of his mechanical sheep!  

Exploding sheep... now why would you even make such a thing!?
I require assistance in recovering a piece of my Illusionist's Attire, Al'tabim.
Aright *hic*... Say, you look familiar *hic*. Have I ever told you about the time me and Windsor fought off thir, er... a thous... a million orcs?$B$BOh settle down friend, this is a good one!
Have you heard of the brood mother of the Black Flight? I believe she is called Onyxia...

Greetings!  I am here to promote a tournament to test your fishing skill in Stranglethorn.  To participate you need enough might to survive there and have enough skill in fishing to coax the fish from the water.$B$B Come back later when you are more qualified!
Ah, so my minions from the Burning Steppes have brought the dragons...

Lads and ladies. Today can be your greatest day, for today, you fight for the glory of Stormpike! Ride unto the field and grant your enemies no mercy! Strike the savages down and let their Warchief sort em out!
A rogue?  I'm not in the habit of referring people to those types, but I believe Jannok would be the one you're looking for.  You will find him at the Inn in Dolanaar.
Summon forth your cowardly master, fool! Let him face me!
The Dun Baldar South Bunker is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Alliance will destroy it!
These undead rabble, and their dead-elf queen, will fall!
Hope is a DISEASE of the soul! This land shall wither and die!
Ah, Ner'zhul. Not a name that should be uttered lightly, but I did ask you for an answer.$B$BAnd Ner'zhul is the correct one.
Your steel is strong, your skill stronger. Take your steel and your strength to my mate Shayis Steelfury, her skill with armor crafting is unmatched even by me.
I'll go secure below.
And ultimately, it was Ragnaros that named me when I was reborn as an acolyte of fire: Lathoric... Lathoric the Black.
What's needed for the cauldron at Gahrron's Withering?
Hey Nag, how about you slice me off a piece of that...
What can this insignificant servant do for you, $n? Training perhaps?
The Dun Baldar South Bunker protects the south and east flanks of Dun Baldar.$B$BIt is controlled by the Horde.
While Theramore is reknown for it's exceptional training of warriors, I am afraid that I can not help you.
We are the arm of His will.  And we will crush His foes into grave dust!
Arr!   There be nothin I like to see better than folks fightin to the death in the arena.   If you be here at the right time maybe you can be one of them!
What happened to the staff?
I inspect the body further.
A warlock?  Well, if I was a warlock, I would probably be in the darkest place around here... which would be the Lion's Pride Inn basement.  That's where you should look first.
You screamed like a little girl, funniest thing I ever saw.
Be warned that even your creators are fallible.
